target_customer: Retailers, especially luxury and fashion, whose store associates send personalized shoppable lookbooks to clients
problem: Store sales associates have no easy way to keep selling to customers after they leave the store through personalized digital channels.
business_model: B2B SaaS monthly subscription with annual commitment, no commission on sales

founders.name: Christina Czap
founders.background_notes: YC page: former Director at Vogue and a top-grossing salesperson at the named luxury retailers.

founders.name: Felipe Saint-Jean
founders.background_notes: YC page: built a remote learning solution for the NY Department of Education and a fantasy sports app.

competitors.name: Clientbook
competitors.what: Clienteling software for high-end retail, founded 2017 in Lehi, Utah

competitors.name: Salesfloor
competitors.what: Clienteling and virtual shopping platform for retailers

technical_complexity.rationale: Content builder plus email and SMS sending with retail catalog integrations; routine web engineering.

defensibility.rationale: Associate habits and catalog integrations help, but several clienteling vendors already existed and the core flow is simple to copy.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Established clienteling vendors continued to operate; no acquisition or copying of Seer was found.

market_need_then: Retail stores lost foot traffic in 2020 and brands pushed associates to sell remotely; Seer launched in March 2021 after YC per an IADS item.

branding.domain_note: Uses helloseer.com with a hello prefix, not seer.com

identity.voice_and_tone: Taglines: Sell beyond the store; Powering Personalized Sales

brand_strength.rationale: Short evocative word but shared with several unrelated companies named Seer, so search and recall are weak; no press on the brand itself.

outcome_analysis: Seer paired a former luxury retail seller with a Yale computer science PhD and launched in March 2021. It is listed active with a team of 4 and little public traction or funding news. A seed of about $2.3M is claimed only by aggregators, so its trajectory is unclear; clienteling rivals had more funding.
notes: Seed of about $2.3M to $2.4M total (Mar or Apr 2021, investors listed such as Pioneer Fund, Global Founders Capital, Foundation Capital) appears only on aggregators (Caplight, Bounce Watch, Employbl) with conflicting dates, so it is unverified and not recorded as a round. Competitor source dates are not known; Clientbook and Salesfloor existed before 2021 per their company pages but I did not open a dated source. YC lists location as San Francisco or Menlo Park. Company website fetch was rate limited, so no site check. Seer name is shared by unrelated companies (Seer Interactive, Seer Proteograph).
